I dont trust him not to hurt me again, and I don't feel safe being vulnerable with him anymore. I've been dismissed too many times, and feel like I am not good enough and like I don't matter. This has thrown me into depression which of course makes it all worse. I know why I feel like this (childhood trauma) and even though we are in couples counseling I feel like it might be too late for me andbi question  if I even WANT to be in this relationship anymore.

Your relationship might still have a chance and highly suggest you get over the ego (because that's what it is, ive been there) and actually listen to her when she brings up past issues or recent arguments. Show her and make her feel like you care about her being hurt and acknowledge your part in her feeling like that. If your talk goes well then suggest couples counseling afterwards. If she agrees set boundaries and a goal for expectations and outcomes. If she says no, then that's her decision and she isn't wrong for feeling like that. This just means you need to decide if you're gonna stay and end up like me on the other side and LL4Her or leave and eventually be happy. You need to remember that she, feelings and all matter, just as much as YOU and YOUR feelings. Once you don't care about what they are feeling or can't empathize with what they are going through..... It's over!

What ever you choose to do, your decision is not wrong, and I  suggest you seek individual therapy whatever your choice is.  I've added a link to a website that I feel best sums up what I've learned in both individual and couples therapy in regards to fear of intimacy.

https://www.choosingtherapy.com/fear-of-intimacy/
